summary: The registrant filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering of up to $35,280,213.01 of Class A common stock through sales agent Pacific Century Securities. The shares are sold at market prices on Nasdaq, with a 3.0% commission. No fixed price, premium, or special-situation mechanics apply; proceeds fund working capital and general purposes. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation.
